min_required_version.description: Minimum app version required. Users on lower versions will be forced to update.

latest_version.description: Latest available app version. Users on lower versions will be prompted with an optional update.

is_maintenance_mode.description: Master switch to enable or disable app maintenance mode overlay.

force_update_title.description: Title text shown on mandatory force update modal.

defaultValue.value: A mandatory update is required to continue using Expendly. Please update to the latest version.

force_update_message.description: Description message shown on mandatory force update modal.

optional_update_title.description: Title text shown on optional update modal.

defaultValue.value: A new update is available with new features and performance enhancements.

optional_update_message.description: Description message shown on optional update modal.

maintenance_title.description: Header title displayed when app is in maintenance mode.

defaultValue.value: Expendly is currently undergoing maintenance to serve you better. Please check back soon.

maintenance_message.description: Subtext message displayed when app is in maintenance mode.

update_url_android.description: Play Store URL for downloading app updates on Android.

update_url_ios.description: App Store URL for downloading app updates on iOS.
